== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Champions are legendary, superhuman warriors belonging to the [[Champion’s Guild]], an organization second in age only to the [[Consultants]]. Historically, they have been a cornerstone of [[Imperial]] history, with their involvement often determining the outcome of wars and the unification of [[The Empire|the Empire]]. While they are more than just [[Soulbound]], their true power stems from a secret alchemical process that enhances their physical and mental capabilities. This process, which involves proprietary formulas kept secret by the [[Guild]], grants them immense strength, durability, and a natural resistance to poisons. Because of these enhancements, they are considered nearly invincible in direct combat, though they may be vulnerable to assassination or specialized alchemical restraints. From a young age, Champions undergo an intense and abusive regimen of combat training and mental conditioning designed to instill the belief that victory is their only virtue. This upbringing often includes psychological tactics to ensure they feel superior to others. In the modern era, Champions frequently participate in duels or exhibition matches to demonstrate an employer's power. Despite their reputation for being unstoppable, the [[Champion’s Guild]] has faced dissolution, with its leadership transitioning from a formal guild structure to individual Champions. The symbol of the [[Guild]] is the [[Golden Crown]].}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The Champions are superhuman warriors created through a secret process and trained from birth to be unstoppable in combat. As the second oldest [[Imperial]] [[Guild]] after the [[Consultants]], they traditionally eschew stealth, preferring to kill their targets in a straight line. Although [[Calder]] once feared they might punish him for listening to treason, the group has since remained neutral or potentially disbanded. Following the dissolution of the [[Champion’s Guild|Champion's Guild]], only individual Champions remain, though some have been observed on the deck of the [[Navigator’s ship|Navigator's ship]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Champions]] are superhuman products of a secret process, trained from birth to be unstoppable in battle.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c5">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Calder]] feared the [[Champions]] might punish him for listening to treason.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c7">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Champions]] have remained neutral or possibly disbanded.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c8">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Champions]] do not concern themselves with stealth and kill in a straight line to their targets.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c10">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Champion’s Guild|Champion's Guild]] has been dissolved, leaving only individual [[Champions]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c18">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 18</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Champions]] are the second oldest [[Imperial]] [[Guild]], following the [[Consultants]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c18" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|There are [[Champions]] on the deck of the [[Navigator’s ship|Navigator's ship]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c22">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Champions are warriors belonging to [[Calder]] who maintain a chapter house located on Peregrine Street. These individuals are built specifically for battle, though they recently suffered the loss of three members. During an encounter with [[Alchemists|alchemists]], the group faced various hazards including gas, [[darts]], traps, and adhesive. Despite these intense attacks, the Champions do not give up easily. Ultimately, [[Kelarac]] dispatched them to save [[Calder]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Champions]] were attacked by [[Alchemists|alchemists]] using gas, [[darts]], traps, and adhesive.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c7">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Champions]] do not give up easily.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Champions]] are individuals built for battle.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c13">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Champions]] are warriors belonging to [[Calder]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c13" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Three [[Champions]] were recently killed.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Champions]] have a chapter house on Peregrine street.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 17</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Kelarac]] sent the [[Champions]] to save [[Calder]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Champions are characterized by sticky, poisoned bodies that require more frequent and potent drinks than any other individuals. Their physical forms adapt uniquely to [[Kameira grafts]] and various alchemical augmentations. Following the death of the Emperor, the group ceased taking any official actions on behalf of the [[Guild]]. During a specific conflict, their decision to engage without [[Estyr]] and her [[Vessels]] resulted in an immediate defeat, and by the conclusion of the battle, two of their number had vanished. Furthermore, those Champions who maintained loyalty to [[Calder]] were systematically removed as part of a larger plan.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Champions]] entering the fight without [[Estyr]] and her [[Vessels]] meant an instant defeat.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Champions]] are described as sticky and poisoned.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Champions]] require more and stronger drinks than anyone else.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c12">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Champions]] have bodies that adapt differently to alchemical augmentations and [[Kameira grafts]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Champions]] haven't taken any official [[Guild]] actions since shortly after the Emperor’s death.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Champions]] loyal to [[Calder]] were being removed as part of a plan.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The two [[Champions]] were gone after the battle.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c18">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 18</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
